2608.04170.title: Visualizing Graph-to-Answer Mechanism Recovery in Materials-Science Hypothesis Generation
2608.04170.paper_summary: AI co-scientists can generate fluent materials-science hypotheses, but fluency does not show that an answer preserves a scientifically meaningful mechanism. We present a graph-to-answer mechanism-tracing case study for Graph-PRefLexOR-8B, a Qwen3-8B model adapted to expose distinct stages for brainstorming, graph construction, pattern extraction, and synthesis. We organize semantic backtracking, graph corruption, activation-based recovery measurements, and layer-by-token-region grids into a visual diagnostic workflow for inspecting this pathway. Across 100 open-ended materials-science questions, final answers remain closest to the model's own structured stages, especially synthesis. Under graph corruption, a full sweep over 37 residual-stream checkpoints, the embedding output and 36 transformer blocks, shows little mechanism recovery in the earlier transition region at layers 7--10, recovery instead concentrates in late synthesis and answer-start regions around layers 30 and 36. The workflow is intended to help scientists and model developers identify where a generated hypothesis loses or regains mechanism support before it is passed to downstream experimental planning.
2608.04170.paper_summary_zh: AI 共同科學家能夠生成流暢的材料科學假設，但流暢性並不表示答案保留了科學上有意義的機制。我們提出了一個針對 Graph-PRefLexOR-8B 的圖到答案機制追蹤案例研究，這是一個調整過的 Qwen3-8B 模型，用於揭示頭腦風暴、圖形構建、模式提取和合成的不同階段。我們將語義回溯、圖形損壞、基於激活的恢復測量和按標記區域的層級網格組織成一個視覺診斷工作流程，以檢查這一過程。在 100 個開放式材料科學問題中，最終答案與模型自身的結構階段最為接近，特別是在合成階段。在圖形損壞的情況下，對 37 個剩餘流檢查點的全面掃描、嵌入輸出和 36 個Transformer塊顯示，在第 7 到 10 層的早期過渡區域幾乎沒有機制恢復，恢復則集中在第 30 和 36 層的晚期合成和答案開始區域。該工作流程旨在幫助科學家和模型開發者識別生成的假設在傳遞到下游實驗規劃之前，在哪裡失去或重新獲得機制支持。
